units.source_text: 走着走着，不知不觉间来到了弹子房、小酒馆林立的明亮的闹市尽头，

en.t: As he walked on, before he knew it he had reached the bright edge of the busy district lined with pachinko parlors and small bars,

units.source_text: 开始看见一个角落在黑暗中很有规则地排列着成排的董光灯和微微发白的纸灯笼。

en.t: and he began to see, in one dark corner, rows of Dongguang lamps and faintly whitish paper lanterns arranged in very regular order.
